title: Split the mailbox read-timing code out of src/mailboxes.rs (3,349 lines) into its own module
outcome: The read-timing measurement (MailboxStoreTimings, MailboxReadStageTimings and slow_report, RequestReceivedAt with stamp_request_received_at, MeasuredMailboxRead, read_mailbox_measured and read_mailbox_routed) lives in its own module with the provenance header the repository asks for, as a pure code move; src/mailboxes.rs keeps only the timed acquisition helpers and returns below the ~3,000-line threshold.
acceptance: A new module (for example src/mailbox_read_timing.rs) holds the read-timing code with a header stating what it owns, what it does not own, and the file it was split out of; the move is pure (no renames, no signature changes, no new imports beyond what the move requires); src/mailboxes.rs is below 3,000 lines.
cargo check is clean and the mailbox and delegation_mcp test modules pass unchanged in the named root.
